svg.text: Same tool, two answer keys: author vs blind manifests
Current run (after member facts). The blind manifests were written by a separate agent that never saw the Cypher or the presets.
author manifests (written with the rules in view)
blind manifests (written without the rule code)
The gap is a reading gap, not yet a tool error: 39 rows where the manifests and the tool disagree wait for the author.
Example: hexagonal adapter → adapter is FF-S03 (advisory) for the author, FF-S01 (blocking) for the blind reader — construct question Q5.
Source: Docs/DiagnosticRuns/v1.3-reference-after-member-facts-2026-10-15.md §3 ("Per style, author view" and "Per style, blind (expanded), blocking"); adjudication rows:
Blind protocol: Docs/v1.3/validation-protocol.md §1. The blind manifests themselves are sealed and were not opened for this kit.
